# US-China Trade War: Tariffs, Trade Volumes, and Supply Chain Shifts (2016–2024)

## Overview
This collection of datasets tracks the evolution of the US-China trade war from 2016 to 2024, covering tariff rate changes, bilateral trade volumes, supply chain diversification patterns, and key policy milestones.

## Data Source

### tariff_rates
Average effective tariff rates by half-year period (2017-H1 to 2024-H1). Fields: `period` (string, format YYYY-HX), `us_tariff_on_china` (percent, range 3.1–25.4), `china_tariff_on_us` (percent, range 8.0–23.1). Rates represent trade-weighted averages across all tariff lines.

### bilateral_trade
Annual US-China bilateral trade from 2016 to 2024. Fields: `year` (integer), `us_exports_to_china` (billion USD), `us_imports_from_china` (billion USD), `total_bilateral` (billion USD, sum of exports and imports).

### supply_chain_share
Annual share of total US goods imports by source. Fields: `year` (integer), `china` (percent), `vietnam` (percent), `india` (percent), `rest_of_world` (percent). Values for each year sum to approximately 100%.

### policy_events
Key policy milestones. Fields: `date` (ISO date string), `period_approx` (corresponding half-year period), `event` (short description), `category` (one of: investigation, tariff, deal, review). Contains 12 events spanning August 2017 to May 2024.

## Data Notes
- Tariff rates are approximate trade-weighted averages and may differ from statutory rates on specific product categories
- 2024 data is partial (H1 only for tariffs; full-year trade figures are estimates)
- Supply chain shares are rounded and may not sum to exactly 100%
- Rest-of-world is a residual category capturing all non-China, non-Vietnam, non-India imports

# US-China Trade War: Tariffs, Trade Volumes, and Supply Chain Shifts (2016–2024)

## Overview
This collection of datasets tracks the evolution of the US-China trade war from 2016 to 2024, covering tariff rate changes, bilateral trade volumes, supply chain diversification patterns, and key policy milestones.

## Data Source

### tariff_rates
Average effective tariff rates by half-year period (2017-H1 to 2024-H1). Fields: `period` (string, format YYYY-HX), `us_tariff_on_china` (percent, range 3.1–25.4), `china_tariff_on_us` (percent, range 8.0–23.1). Rates represent trade-weighted averages across all tariff lines.

### bilateral_trade
Annual US-China bilateral trade from 2016 to 2024. Fields: `year` (integer), `us_exports_to_china` (billion USD), `us_imports_from_china` (billion USD), `total_bilateral` (billion USD, sum of exports and imports).

### supply_chain_share
Annual share of total US goods imports by source. Fields: `year` (integer), `china` (percent), `vietnam` (percent), `india` (percent), `rest_of_world` (percent). Values for each year sum to approximately 100%.

### policy_events
Key policy milestones. Fields: `date` (ISO date string), `period_approx` (corresponding half-year period), `event` (short description), `category` (one of: investigation, tariff, deal, review). Contains 12 events spanning August 2017 to May 2024.

## Data Notes
- Tariff rates are approximate trade-weighted averages and may differ from statutory rates on specific product categories
- 2024 data is partial (H1 only for tariffs; full-year trade figures are estimates)
- Supply chain shares are rounded and may not sum to exactly 100%
- Rest-of-world is a residual category capturing all non-China, non-Vietnam, non-India imports

import json
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches

import numpy as np
from matplotlib.lines import Line2D

with open('/app/benchmark/source_data.json') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

# --- Color palette (editorial, muted, publication-ready) ---
C_US_TARIFF = '#C44E52'       # muted red
C_CN_TARIFF = '#DD8452'       # burnt orange
C_TRADE_VOL = '#4C72B0'       # steel blue
C_CHINA_SHARE = '#C44E52'     # muted red (declining)
C_VIETNAM = '#55A868'         # sage green
C_INDIA = '#8172B3'           # muted purple
C_EVENT_LINE = '#555555'
C_BG = '#FAFAFA'
C_GRID = '#E0E0E0'
C_TEXT = '#333333'

# --- Parse data ---
tariff_data = data['tariff_rates']['data']
tariff_periods = [d['period'] for d in tariff_data]
us_tariff = [d['us_tariff_on_china'] for d in tariff_data]
cn_tariff = [d['china_tariff_on_us'] for d in tariff_data]

trade_data = data['bilateral_trade']['data']
trade_years = [d['year'] for d in trade_data]
total_bilateral = [d['total_bilateral'] for d in trade_data]
us_exports = [d['us_exports_to_china'] for d in trade_data]
us_imports = [d['us_imports_from_china'] for d in trade_data]

sc_data = data['supply_chain_share']['data']
sc_years = [d['year'] for d in sc_data]
sc_china = [d['china'] for d in sc_data]
sc_vietnam = [d['vietnam'] for d in sc_data]
sc_india = [d['india'] for d in sc_data]

events = data['policy_events']['data']

# Map half-year periods to numeric x for tariff panel
period_to_x = {}
for i, p in enumerate(tariff_periods):
    period_to_x[p] = i
tariff_x = list(range(len(tariff_periods)))

# Map years to x for trade/supply-chain panels
year_to_x_trade = {y: i for i, y in enumerate(trade_years)}
year_to_x_sc = {y: i for i, y in enumerate(sc_years)}

# --- Figure setup: 3 panels stacked ---
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 18), facecolor=C_BG)
gs = gridspec.GridSpec(3, 1, height_ratios=[1.1, 0.9, 0.9], hspace=0.28,
                       left=0.08, right=0.92, top=0.92, bottom=0.05)

fig.text(0.5, 0.965,
         'US–China Trade War Dynamics: Tariffs, Trade Volumes & Supply Chain Shifts (2016–2024)',
         ha='center', va='center', fontsize=17, fontweight='bold', color=C_TEXT,
         fontfamily='serif')
fig.text(0.5, 0.945,
         'How tariff escalation reshaped bilateral trade and accelerated supply chain diversification',
         ha='center', va='center', fontsize=11, color='#666666', fontstyle='italic',
         fontfamily='serif')

# ============================================================
# PANEL 1: Tariff escalation with policy event annotations
# ============================================================
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0])
ax1.set_facecolor(C_BG)

ax1.step(tariff_x, us_tariff, where='post', linewidth=2.5, color=C_US_TARIFF,
         label='US tariff on Chinese goods', zorder=3)
ax1.step(tariff_x, cn_tariff, where='post', linewidth=2.5, color=C_CN_TARIFF,
         linestyle='--', label='China tariff on US goods', zorder=3)

ax1.fill_between(tariff_x, us_tariff, alpha=0.10, step='post', color=C_US_TARIFF)
ax1.fill_between(tariff_x, cn_tariff, alpha=0.08, step='post', color=C_CN_TARIFF)

# Annotate policy events
selected_events = [
    ("2017-H2", "Section 301\nInvestigation", "investigation"),
    ("2018-H1", "§301 Memo\n($50B announced)", "tariff"),
    ("2018-H2", "Lists 1–3\n($250B @ 10–25%)", "tariff"),
    ("2019-H1", "List 3 raised\nto 25%", "tariff"),
    ("2019-H2", "List 4A\n($112B @ 15%)", "tariff"),
    ("2020-H1", "Phase One\nDeal Signed", "deal"),
    ("2021-H2", "USTR Tai\nTariff Review", "review"),
    ("2024-H1", "Biden: EVs 100%\nChips 50%", "tariff"),
]

cat_colors = {'investigation': '#7570B3', 'tariff': C_US_TARIFF, 'deal': '#1B9E77', 'review': '#D95F02'}
y_offsets = [12, 18, 26, 24, 23, 22, 22, 28]

for idx, (period, label, cat) in enumerate(selected_events):
    if period in period_to_x:
        x_pos = period_to_x[period]
        y_val = us_tariff[tariff_x.index(x_pos)] if x_pos in tariff_x else 10
        y_top = y_offsets[idx]
        ax1.axvline(x=x_pos, ymin=0, ymax=0.85, color=cat_colors[cat],
                    linewidth=0.8, linestyle=':', alpha=0.6, zorder=1)
        ax1.annotate(label, xy=(x_pos, y_top), fontsize=7.2,
                     ha='center', va='bottom', color=cat_colors[cat],
                     fontweight='bold', fontfamily='serif',
                     bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.2', facecolor='white',
                               edgecolor=cat_colors[cat], alpha=0.85, linewidth=0.6))

ax1.set_ylabel('Average Effective Tariff Rate (%)', fontsize=11, color=C_TEXT, fontfamily='serif')
ax1.set_title('Panel A: Tariff Escalation Timeline with Policy Milestones',
              fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', color=C_TEXT, fontfamily='serif', loc='left', pad=10)
ax1.set_xticks(tariff_x)
ax1.set_xticklabels(tariff_periods, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=8.5)
ax1.set_ylim(0, 32)
ax1.set_xlim(-0.5, len(tariff_x) - 0.5)
ax1.grid(axis='y', color=C_GRID, linewidth=0.5, zorder=0)
ax1.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax1.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
ax1.spines['left'].set_color('#AAAAAA')
ax1.spines['bottom'].set_color('#AAAAAA')
ax1.tick_params(colors=C_TEXT, labelsize=9)

legend_elements_1 = [
    Line2D([0], [0], color=C_US_TARIFF, linewidth=2.5, label='US tariff on Chinese goods'),
    Line2D([0], [0], color=C_CN_TARIFF, linewidth=2.5, linestyle='--', label='China tariff on US goods'),
]
cat_legend = [
    Line2D([0], [0], color=cat_colors['tariff'], linewidth=0, marker='s', markersize=7,
           label='Tariff action'),
    Line2D([0], [0], color=cat_colors['deal'], linewidth=0, marker='s', markersize=7,
           label='Trade deal'),
    Line2D([0], [0], color=cat_colors['investigation'], linewidth=0, marker='s', markersize=7,
           label='Investigation'),
    Line2D([0], [0], color=cat_colors['review'], linewidth=0, marker='s', markersize=7,
           label='Policy review'),
]
leg1 = ax1.legend(handles=legend_elements_1 + cat_legend, loc='upper left',
                  fontsize=8, frameon=True, fancybox=False, edgecolor='#CCCCCC',
                  ncol=3, columnspacing=1.0)
leg1.get_frame().set_facecolor('white')

# ============================================================
# PANEL 2: Bilateral trade volume (stacked bar: exports + imports)
# ============================================================
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1])
ax2.set_facecolor(C_BG)

bar_width = 0.55
trade_x_pos = np.arange(len(trade_years))

bars_imp = ax2.bar(trade_x_pos, us_imports, width=bar_width,
                   color=C_TRADE_VOL, alpha=0.8, label='US Imports from China', zorder=2)
bars_exp = ax2.bar(trade_x_pos, us_exports, width=bar_width, bottom=us_imports,
                   color='#8CB4D8', alpha=0.8, label='US Exports to China', zorder=2)

for i, (xi, tot) in enumerate(zip(trade_x_pos, total_bilateral)):
    ax2.text(xi, tot + 8, f'${tot:.0f}B', ha='center', va='bottom',
             fontsize=7.8, color=C_TEXT, fontweight='bold', fontfamily='serif')

# Highlight dip region
ax2.axvspan(trade_x_pos[3] - 0.4, trade_x_pos[4] + 0.4,
            alpha=0.08, color=C_US_TARIFF, zorder=0)
ax2.annotate('Peak tariff\nimpact', xy=(trade_x_pos[3.5 if False else 3] + 0.5, 380),
             fontsize=8, ha='center', color=C_US_TARIFF, fontstyle='italic',
             fontfamily='serif')

ax2.set_ylabel('Bilateral Trade (Billion USD)', fontsize=11, color=C_TEXT, fontfamily='serif')
ax2.set_title('Panel B: US–China Bilateral Trade Volume',
              fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', color=C_TEXT, fontfamily='serif', loc='left', pad=10)
ax2.set_xticks(trade_x_pos)
ax2.set_xticklabels(trade_years, fontsize=9.5)
ax2.set_ylim(0, 780)
ax2.grid(axis='y', color=C_GRID, linewidth=0.5, zorder=0)
ax2.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax2.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
ax2.spines['left'].set_color('#AAAAAA')
ax2.spines['bottom'].set_color('#AAAAAA')
ax2.tick_params(colors=C_TEXT, labelsize=9)

leg2 = ax2.legend(loc='upper right', fontsize=9, frameon=True, fancybox=False,
                  edgecolor='#CCCCCC')
leg2.get_frame().set_facecolor('white')

ax3.set_facecolor(C_BG)

ax3.plot(sc_x_pos, sc_vietnam, color=C_VIETNAM, linewidth=2.5, marker='s',

ax3.fill_between(sc_x_pos, sc_india, alpha=0.08, color=C_INDIA)

             fontsize=8, color=C_CHINA_SHARE, fontweight='bold', fontfamily='serif',

ax3.annotate('Vietnam\nshare +133%',

ax3.set_title('Panel C: Supply Chain Diversification — Rising Alternatives to China',

ax3.set_xticks(sc_x_pos)

leg3 = ax3.legend(loc='upper right', fontsize=9.5, frameon=True, fancybox=False,

leg3.get_frame().set_facecolor('white')
